title: Evershore Logistics pilot onboarding roadmap & success path
summary: Working kickoff doc for a 6-week pilot with Evershore Logistics to validate Redwood Inference as a low-latency routing assistant for freight quoting. Focus is on integration surface, baseline latency/cost targets, and an operational runbook for handover to their platform team.
objectives: Primary: demonstrate end-to-end inference latency < 350ms p95 for short prompts (<= 128 tokens) and per-quote cost < $0.015 on average using a quantized candidate model. Secondary: validate secure private deployment option using VPC peering and show minimal quality regressions vs. their current rules-based heuristics.
success_criteria:
1) Latency: p95 <= 350ms for 90% of incoming quote requests during 500-request stress test.
2) Cost: average token cost and infra cost per quote <= $0.015 during benchmark window.
3) Quality: Accuracy (business metric) >= 92% relative to labeled ground truth on 300-sample eval set; no critical misroutes in safety review.
4) Reliability: zero unrecoverable errors during a 4-hour continuous soak test and automatic fallback to rules-based path on degraded performance.
5) Security/Compliance: successful KMS integration and audit log ingestion into Evershore SIEM with no PII leakage flagged in sample traces.
kickoff_agenda:
- Introductions and objectives (10m)
- Scope and out-of-scope items (10m)
- Data and integration touchpoints: API, event bus, S3 artifacts (20m)
- Success metrics and evaluation plan (15m)
- Deployment model options (hosted vs. private) and immediate recommendation (10m)
- Roles & ownership, escalation paths (10m)
- Timeline & checkpoints (10m)
- Next steps and action items (5m)
roles_and_responsibilities:
Redwood: SE lead (Maya) - overall coordination; infra engineer (Ravi) - testbed and private deployment; applied-ML (Lena) - model selection, quantization guidance; SRE (Oliver) - monitoring/soak testing setup.
Evershore: Platform lead (Priya) - networking & SIEM onboarding; Data engineering (TBD) - ground-truth dataset and sample payloads; Product (TBD) - acceptance signoff and business metric owner.
timeline_milestones: Week 0: Kickoff & access granted (SLA, IAM, sample data) - target 2024-07-12
Week 1: Integration PoC - sample API adapters + first inference runs
Week 2: Model tuning & quantized profile evaluation; collect quality metrics
Week 3: Soak testing and routing fallback validation; performance tuning
Week 4: Business evaluation with labeled set; cost analysis and optimization suggestions
Week 5: Harden private deployment (if chosen) and run security checklist
Week 6: Final review, acceptance criteria check, handover docs and runbook
measurement_plan:
- Latency: instrument p50/p95/p99 at the request ingress and post-runtime gateway. Use synthetic traffic and production-matched traces.
- Cost: capture token counts, infer runtime GPU-minute consumption, and map to per-quote $cost.
- Quality: holdout eval set (300 samples) + live A/B: compare predictions to rules baseline and compute business metric (accuracy, uplift).
- Observability: configure per-route dashboards in Console and export key traces to Evershore SIEM for audit.
- Acceptance gating: automated checklist that asserts all success criteria thresholds and produces an acceptance artifact for signoff.
risks_and_mitigations:
- Network bandwidth variability: mitigate by running tests across Evershore regions and caching heavy prefixes; set conservative fallbacks.
- Data sensitivity: anonymize sample payloads, validate KMS integration early.
- Quality regressions under quantization: keep a non-quantized fallback and A/B test; apply small-batch fine-tune if necessary.
- Unexpected burst traffic: configure autoscale policies for Dedicated or apply rate limiting with graceful degradation routes.
- Integration delays (S3, event bus): have a stubbed ingestion path and synthetic generator for early testing.
next_steps:
1) Evershore to provide sample payloads + a short labeled set (200-300 rows) by 2024-07-15.
2) Redwood SE to provision a sandbox tenant and share access details by 2024-07-16.
3) Joint integration session scheduled for 2024-07-17 (2 hours).
4) Define acceptance meeting for Week 6 with stakeholders listed above; assign acceptance owner.
5) Action owners update this doc with task ownerships in the linked JIRA board (SE-2148).
